title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a hexadecimal view to the Session 1 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 app shows the lamps and the decimal number but not the hexadecimal digit that stands for the pattern.

## Context
Session 2 introduces hexadecimal; seeing it next to the lamps in Session 1 prepares students.

## Expected outcome
The readout also shows the hex digit (0 to F) for the four switches.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The readout shows the hex digit for every pattern
- [ ] The challenge still works

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: a carry-lookahead adder
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Session 3 shows that the carry delay of a ripple adder grows as 2n + 1; real processors avoid this.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Add Session 5: a 4-bit multiplier from gates
body:
## Problem
The simulator can add and subtract but not multiply.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the learner builds a 4 x 4 multiplier from AND gates and adders and checks it on all 256 pairs.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All 256 products match Python
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: an 8-bit adder with lit carry wires
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows an 8-bit adder with a rippling carry; there is no public implementation of the animation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own animation of the 8-bit adder-subtractor, with switches, lit carry wires, a result and an overflow flag.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The carry visibly ripples through the stages
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
